candidates.claim: Effective OT_IN entry fw-01:80 permits OT hosts (10.10.10.0/24) to any destination (0.0.0.0/0, including OUTSIDE, CORP and DMZ) on tcp/443, bound inbound on the ot interface, and no approved cross-zone service covers this path.
candidates.remediation: Remove the OT_IN entry at fw-01:80 or restrict it to an approved destination, and reconcile it with the baseline.

candidates.claim: Effective DMZ_IN entry fw-01:68 permits the jump host 10.10.20.30 to reach all OT addresses (10.10.10.0/24) on any protocol, bound inbound on the dmz interface, whereas the approved service is only tcp/3389 to the engineering workstation 10.10.10.40 (A4).
candidates.remediation: Narrow the DMZ_IN entry at fw-01:68 to tcp/3389 to 10.10.10.40 or remove it, and reconcile it with the baseline.

candidates.claim: sw-core-01 has a read-write SNMP community (mode RW) with no access ACL, while policy requires read-only communities restricted by an ACL that permits only MGMT hosts.
candidates.remediation: Remove the RW SNMP community, or make it read-only and bind it to an ACL that permits only 10.10.99.50.

candidates.claim: sw-ot-01 sends logging to 192.168.30.77, which is in CORP (192.168.30.0/24) and outside MGMT, while policy requires logging destinations to be inside MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the 192.168.30.77 logging host from sw-ot-01 or replace it with an MGMT syslog address such as 10.10.99.60.
